name: Holywell Bay Holiday Park
stayType: Holiday park with caravans, glamping and pitches
accommodation: Caravans, bungalows, glamping safari tents and touring and camping pitches (including electric hook-up)
beachAccess: A short walk from Holywell Bay beach
confirmedFeatures: Heated outdoor pool with waterslide, bar and grill, shop, kids' clubs, adventure playground, games room, surf school, free Wi-Fi in designated areas
overview: A Parkdean Resorts holiday park a short walk from the beach at Holywell Bay. Stays range from caravans and bungalows to glamping safari tents and touring pitches. On site there is a heated outdoor pool with a long waterslide, a bar and grill, kids' clubs, a shop and a surf school.
surfTripFit: A short walk to the beach and a surf school on site make it an easy base for a family surf trip.
